comments.text: Ca ca 10 veicle hitch from Rishikesh to Dharmsala. A few weeks time.  Don't leave Dharmsala after sunset - elephant danger. Dont hestiate to ask water from alchol shop. Wellwater drinkable. Drinking water tast better and better when moving up the Himalayan mountains. People friendly.
